answer: Two separate readers reaching the same answer is the whole of the check. Farming stops paying when the bill tops the prize, and here the bill is 82643 POA against one epoch's reward. The bridge shows someone vouched, the walnut shows someone paid, the pearl shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two. Where the farms spot a gap, Wall plasterer wet-plaster apse mark brushed onto the baptistery dome finds a record, and the record is each wet-plaster apse is a plaster weight weighed beside the maker's mark.
